Sustainability & Environment

We take responsibility. For your skin. And our planet.

Learn more about our sustainability program

We are committed to continually improving the environmental footprint of our products.
Environmental Impact
Compared to other face care products sold in the European market
Together with over 70 cosmetics companies & associations we have developed a science-based environmental impact assessment and scoring system.  Products that score “A” rank amongst the best in class of the face care category for having a lower environmental impact. Products that score “E” have a higher impact and are therefore key products to focus our efforts to improve their environmental performance.

About

Eucerin® Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Normal to Combination Skin Immediately reduces skin redness and calms irritated skin. Skin feels instantly soothed. Skin comfort is improved for a healthy complexion.
NART: 69746-09900-08

Read more about our product

Eucerin® Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Normal to Combination Skin 

Immediately reduces skin redness and calms irritated skin. Skin feels instantly soothed. Skin comfort is improved for a healthy complexion.

Contains SymSitive, active ingredient developed for hypersensitive skin, that effectively acts as a sensitivity regulator directly at the source of the hyperreactivity, instantly calming the skin.

 - Restores skin comfort

 - Improves skin condition

 - Prevents irritative skin reappearance

Very good efficacy and tolerability on hypersensitive skin

0% Alcohol and Fragrances

How to Use

Apply daily in the morning on well cleansed face, by gently massaging into the skin. Visibly red areas might require more product. - Fast absorbing - Light texture - Non-sticky feel

Main findings

*Clinical study with 647 patients, 4 weeks of regular use
86%
confirm alleviation of skin problems*

Clinical Formula

SymSitive

SymSitive* is a soothing ingredient designed for sensitive skin. Its unique neurosensory action provides both immediate and long-lasting relief from discomforts like stinging, burning, and itching, helping to calm and protect the skin.

*registered trademark of Symrise, Germany

FAQ

Does Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Normal to combination skin offer any sun protection?

No. If you have sensitive skin with redness and need a day cream with UV protection, try Eucerin Anti-Redness Concealing Day Care SPF 30. Alternatively all products in the Eucerin SUN range have been tested on sensitive skin.

When can I use Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care for normal to combination skin?

If you have hypersensitive normal to combination skin and want a gentle but effective day and/or night cream.
